workbench.skills.toast.updatesAvailable.value: {count, plural, one {# skill} other {# skills}} can be updated.

workbench.skills.toggleHelp.installInto.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle in the discover sheet, where the circles pick install targets.

workbench.skills.toggleHelp.keepLinks.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle in the import sheet's already-shared section.
workbench.skills.toggleHelp.keepLinks.value: Keep the {app} links already on disk

workbench.skills.toggleHelp.linkAfterAdo.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle beside an unmanaged directory in the import sheet.

workbench.skills.toggleState.coupledGemi.comment: Tooltip on AntiGravity's circle when the skill reaches it through the Gemini CLI folder.
workbench.skills.toggleState.coupledGemi.value: {app} — visible through the Gemini CLI projection it also reads. Click to give it its own projection.

workbench.skills.toggleState.coupledShar.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle for a harness that scans the shared root and has no switch.
workbench.skills.toggleState.coupledShar.value: {app} reads the shared skills root directly, so this skill is always available there. There is no per-skill switch to flip.

workbench.skills.toggleState.disabledInH.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle whose harness switched the skill off in its own config.
workbench.skills.toggleState.disabledInH.value: {app} — projected, but disabled by its native config. Click to enable.

workbench.skills.toggleState.enabled.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle that is on purely because Vibe Bar linked the skill there.
workbench.skills.toggleState.enabled.value: {app} — enabled by projection. Click to remove it.

workbench.skills.toggleState.enabledNati.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle that is on and whose harness has its own per-skill switch.
workbench.skills.toggleState.enabledNati.value: {app} — projected and enabled. Click to disable in the harness; right-click for projection options.

workbench.skills.toggleState.enabledShar.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle that is on for a harness that would find the skill anyway.
workbench.skills.toggleState.enabledShar.value: {app} — has its own link, and also reads the shared skills root directly. There is no per-skill switch; right-click to manage the redundant link.

workbench.skills.toggleState.notProjecte.comment: Tooltip on an installed skill's harness circle when nothing links the skill there.

workbench.skills.toggleState.unknown.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle whose harness config could not be read.
workbench.skills.toggleState.unknown.value: {app} — projected, but native config could not be parsed. Click to repair as enabled.

workbench.skills.uninstall.comment: Destructive button in the uninstall confirmation dialog.

workbench.skills.uninstallConfirmMessage.comment: Message under the uninstall confirmation title.
workbench.skills.uninstallConfirmMessage.value: The skill is backed up first, and removed from every app that links to it.

workbench.skills.uninstallConfirmTitle.comment: Title of the confirmation dialog for uninstalling a skill.

workbench.skills.wiring.footer.comment: Footer of the per-skill wiring popover: the write scope, in one sentence.
workbench.skills.wiring.footer.value: Vibe Bar writes only inside the skills folders above and the four listed config files, and backs a skill up before uninstalling it.

workbench.skills.wiring.mechanismGeminiC.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line for AntiGravity.
workbench.skills.wiring.mechanismGeminiC.value: Also reads the Gemini CLI skills folder, which holds this skill's Gemini projection.

workbench.skills.wiring.mechanismSharedR.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line for a harness that finds the shared root on its own.
workbench.skills.wiring.mechanismSharedR.value: Scans the shared root itself — no per-app link needed.

workbench.skills.wiring.nativeSwitch.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line naming the harness config entry that switches this skill on or off.

workbench.skills.wiring.noNativeSwitch.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line for a harness with no per-skill switch of its own.
workbench.skills.wiring.noNativeSwitch.value: No per-skill switch — whatever is discovered is active.

workbench.skills.wiring.projectionCopy.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line: Vibe Bar copied the skill into the harness. {path} is a file path.

workbench.skills.wiring.projectionCopyAd.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line for a copy that was already on disk before Vibe Bar recorded it.
workbench.skills.wiring.projectionCopyAd.value: Copy at {path} · adopted from an existing install

workbench.skills.wiring.projectionMissin.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line when nothing links the skill into a harness that needs a link.
workbench.skills.wiring.projectionMissin.value: No entry at {path} — the harness cannot see this skill.

workbench.skills.wiring.projectionSymlin.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line: Vibe Bar linked the skill into the harness. {path} is a file path.
Wiring popover mechanism line for a symlink that was already on disk before Vibe Bar recorded it.
workbench.skills.wiring.projectionSymlin.value: Symlink at {path} · adopted from an existing install

workbench.skills.wiring.reveal.comment: Button in the per-skill wiring popover that opens the skill's directory in Finder.

workbench.skills.wiring.revealHelp.comment: Tooltip on the wiring popover's Reveal button.
workbench.skills.wiring.revealHelp.value: Show the skill's source directory in Finder

workbench.skills.wiring.source.comment: Wiring popover row title for the one real copy of the skill.

workbench.skills.wiring.sourceDetail.comment: Caption under the wiring popover's Source row.
workbench.skills.wiring.sourceDetail.value: One copy of the skill. Every harness below reads this directory or a link to it.

workbench.skills.wiring.stateConfigUnrea.comment: Wiring popover state label: the harness config could not be parsed.

workbench.skills.wiring.stateCoupledGemi.comment: Wiring popover state label: the harness sees the skill through the Gemini CLI folder.

workbench.skills.wiring.stateCoupledShar.comment: Wiring popover state label: the harness scans the shared skills root itself.

workbench.skills.wiring.stateNativeOff.comment: Wiring popover state label: linked, but the harness's own config switches the skill off.

workbench.skills.wiring.stateNotLinked.comment: Wiring popover state label: nothing links the skill into that harness.

workbench.status.cachedQuotas.comment: Workbench header status for the Resets page when no refill is scheduled

workbench.status.indexed.comment: Workbench header status for the Sessions page: how many sessions the local index holds

workbench.status.installed.comment: Workbench header status for the Skills page: how many skills are installed

workbench.status.localIndex.comment: Workbench header status for the Sessions page before anything is indexed

workbench.status.localLedger.comment: Workbench header status for the Usage Stats page before the first query

workbench.status.nextRefill.comment: Workbench header status for the Resets page; countdown is a compact span

workbench.status.sharedLibrary.comment: Workbench header status for the Skills page before anything is installed

workbench.status.updated.comment: Workbench header status for the Usage Stats page; time is a clock time
